Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in Step 2 by misinterpreting the search results for "Bal Vidyalaya Kota address." The search results clearly indicated "Kota, Rajasthan, India" (e.g., from cbseschool.org and icbse.com), but the Planner incorrectly concluded that the location was in Indonesia. The Planner based this false conclusion on a superficial analysis of the domain TLD ".in" (mistakenly associating it with Indonesia rather than India) and a linguistic misunderstanding of the word "kota" (confusing the Indian city name with the Indonesian/Malay word for "city"). This error led to an incorrect foundational assumption that the two institutions were in different countries, causing the subsequent search strategy to focus on verifying if Loreto House was in India to match the erroneous "Indonesia" claim for Bal Vidyalaya, rather than confirming both were in India.
